Editorial Charter & Mission

About WHAT'S GOING ON

A real-time news intelligence platform engineered to aggregate, verify, and contextualize high-velocity national and global reporting from premier wire publications every 3 minutes.

1. The Vision Behind What's Going On

In an era characterized by fragmented media feeds, paywalls, algorithmic echo chambers, and high-frequency news churn, WHAT'S GOING ON (whatgoinon.online) was conceived as a high-density, minimalist broadsheet intelligence terminal.

We combine classical broadsheet aesthetics inspired by century-old legacy papers like The Hindu with cutting-edge real-time aggregation infrastructure. Readers receive instantaneous, continuous dispatches across Indian politics, sovereign governance, global diplomacy, financial markets, technology, and space exploration without sensationalism or clickbait manipulation.

2. Multi-Source Wire Architecture

Every 3 minutes, our automated ingestion engine synchronizes verified RSS feeds, XML dispatches, and public news wires from premier editorial bureaus across India and the globe:

🇮🇳 National Governance & India Wire

Direct feeds from The Hindu, ThePrint, The Wire / Livewire, The Indian Express, NDTV 24x7, Times of India, and Hindustan Times.

🌍 Global Affairs & Diplomacy

International coverage from The New York Times, BBC World News, Reuters, Associated Press, Al Jazeera, and The Guardian.

📈 Markets & Financial Intelligence

Real-time corporate earnings, RBI monetary policy, and macroeconomic trends monitored via Mint, Business Standard, and Financial Express.

🤖 Technology, Space & Science

Tracking deep-tech breakthroughs, semiconductor fabrication, AI policy, and ISRO aerospace launches via TechCrunch and institutional science desks.

3. Original Editorial Summaries & Neutrality

We believe that raw headlines alone are insufficient for informed citizenship. For every incoming wire story, our editorial system presents a fresh, original 2-4 sentence briefing written in our own words. We never copy raw text from publisher articles, ensuring clear differentiation between aggregated source headlines and our analytical syntheses.

Each story card includes prominent attribution to the primary publisher, direct outbound source links, key takeaways, and estimated reading time. Wire rights and full investigative reports remain with their original newsrooms.

⭐ Non-Partisan Independence & Fact Integrity

WHAT'S GOING ON operates independently of political parties, corporate conglomerates, and special interest groups. Our algorithms curate top dispatches based on news significance, institutional impact, and temporal freshness rather than sensationalism or rage engagement.

4. Accessibility & Modern Reader Tools

To support researchers, competitive exam candidates, professionals, and international observers, our portal incorporates advanced digital tools:

  • 3-Minute Auto-Refresh: Seamless background synchronization keeping readers abreast of breaking updates.
  • Audio Voice Narration: Integrated text-to-speech synthesis allowing audio listening of dispatches on the go.
  • Current Affairs & UPSC Hub: Structured matrix breaking down daily news into What Happened, Why It Matters, Impact & Significance, and Key Stakeholders.
  • Local Offline Bookmarks: Save articles directly to your browser for distraction-free reading without account requirements.

5. Corrections & Editorial Contact

Factual accuracy is our paramount standard. If you identify an inaccuracy, attribution error, or technical malfunction, please reach out to our editorial desk immediately via our Contact Page or by writing to editor@whatgoinon.online.
